description: GTFS Schedule basic fixed-stop transit profile

gtfs_id.description: Feed-local opaque text; retain leading zeros.

gtfs_service_time.description: H:MM:SS or HH:MM:SS service-day time; hours may exceed 23; agency timezone governs.

feed.description: Unresolved agency feed; choose and pin an actual feed before ingestion.

documentation.description: Fingerprint of documentation bytes inspected during authoring; not a checksum of dataset rows.

profile.subset: Selected basic Schedule fields; no Realtime, fares, shapes, frequencies, transfers, translations or flexible service.
profile.feed: Unresolved; specification profile only, no agency snapshot is claimed.
conditional_rules: agency_id required for multiple agencies; agency association remains conditional.
At least one route name is required.
Service IDs resolve over the union of calendar and calendar_dates.
Calendar requirements depend on dates-only service; exceptions can introduce service IDs.
Arrival/departure requirements depend on timing and stop position.
profile.blank_values: Optional and conditional CSV blanks need explicit consumer handling; no blanket null/default coercion.
profile.relationships: Only unconditional in-profile references are TableSpec foreign keys; conditional and union references remain stated here.
profile.support: Schema metadata and exact adapter recovery only; no source data ingestion or native equivalence.
profile.data_snapshot: No dataset bytes bundled or SHA-256-pinned. Consumers must select and pin local inputs before execution.
profile.unknown_content: Retain original source fields, files and bytes; unsupported content requires an explicit loss report.
